name: dumbbell walking calf raise
description: Walk forward while rising high onto your toes with each step, holding dumbbells. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Step forward and stay up on your toes.
Alternate steps, keeping your heels lifted.
Walk for the set distance, then lower your heels.
